originalFindings.title: Moisture Test Acceptance / Physical Readiness
originalFindings.observation: Initial hold pending moisture acceptance and subsequent uncertainty were resolved with signed test report sharing acknowledgment, establishing physical readiness for installation.
originalFindings.consequence: Moisture hold closure in DR-B04 established physical readiness, allowing installation to proceed following product selection finalization.
originalFindings.action: None required. Installation proceeded and completed following cure period maintenance.
originalFindings.uncertainty: Initial moisture readings were missing but a signed report was subsequently provided.

evidence.quote: Moisture readings are required before adhesive installation. No readings have been received. Adhesive delivery is scheduled for June 2, not confirmed.
Site diary says moisture passed, based on a phone call. No technician, measured value, or signed test report is identified.
Moisture test passed at 09:10. Signed report MT-210 was shared with the flooring supervisor, who acknowledged receipt.

originalFindings.title: Product Selection / Written Field Release
originalFindings.observation: Design discrepancy between instruction to install Product M and drawing F-12 revision 2 specifying Product N was resolved by a formal RFI response selecting Product N with revised drawing receipt confirmation.
originalFindings.consequence: Written field release for Product N enabled adhesive delivery and installation per documentation in DR-B05.
originalFindings.action: None required. Installation complete with protection maintained until cure period.
originalFindings.uncertainty: Instruction versus Drawing conflict was open until DR-B05 resolution; quantities reconciliation noted but not tracked as a prerequisite finding per assignment scope.

evidence.quote: At 15:00 the crew still lacked the moisture test report. The instruction to install Product M differs from drawing F-12 revision 2 specifying Product N. RFI-042 asks which product applies.
The signed test closes moisture acceptance only. It does not approve an adhesive product.
Adhesive delivered. Formal RFI-042 response selects Product N and drawing F-12 revision 3; response and revision were sent to the flooring supervisor with receipt confirmed at 08:30.

originalFindings.title: Adhesive Delivery Schedule and Completion
originalFindings.observation: Delivery was delayed from scheduled June 2 to booked June 4 due to supplier confirmation issues; installation completed on June 5 following documented release after moisture acceptance.
originalFindings.consequence: Work area L210 flooring installation proceeded after delay; project schedule impact noted.
originalFindings.uncertainty: Delay resolved by completion of work and adhesive delivery.

originalFindings.title: Adhesive Delivery Quantity Discrepancy
originalFindings.observation: Delivery docket lists 20 sealed pails while receiving log records 18 pails; difference has not been reconciled despite installation completion.
originalFindings.consequence: Pending reconciliation of material quantity may impact project records or warranty claims related to delivered adhesive.
originalFindings.action: Receiving lead to reconcile delivery docket count with receiving log count and closeout documentation.
originalFindings.uncertainty: Delivery receipt quantity mismatch remains unreconciled per DR-B05 records.
